parsed.title: Portable prompt hardcodes this repo's script path
parsed.detail: The portable prompt's own premise is 'Do not assume this project matches any other — discover its conventions and adapt' and 'If something doesn't exist, note it; the skills must degrade gracefully... rather than assuming a path'. The edited line instructs the generated system to run 'node scripts/unit-route.mjs <unit>' — a repo-specific script of THIS repository that a freshly regenerated target repo will not have. The prompt now assumes a path exists in the target project, contradicting its declared degrade-gracefully contract.

parsed.title: Internal-step count bumped but enumeration not updated
parsed.detail: The diff changes '18 internal steps' to '19 internal steps' to account for the new `replan-findings`, but the enumerating sentence that follows ('the plan-feature router's two planning steps, the two pre-execution evidence owners..., the review-change findings engine..., the planning-preflight planning gate, the phase-contract lint contract, the verification-contract acceptance guard, the workflow's own 9-skill internal review pack') still does not mention `replan-findings` anywhere, unlike every other category it names. Same in SKILLS.es.md ('19 pasos internos' with the identical enumeration omitting replan-findings).

parsed.title: ES/EN portable prompt blocks are not the same literal prompt
parsed.detail: The ES file declares the embedded block is 'deliberadamente sin traducir — es un prompt literal... Pégalo textualmente sin importar el idioma', i.e. it must be byte-identical to PORTABLE_PROMPT.md's block. But the ES block reads 'on failure recomienda el camino manual `/fold-findings`, y luego un nuevo `/review-change`; los hallazgos no' while the EN block reads 'on failure recommend the manual path `/fold-findings`, then re-run `/review-change`; unresolved findings route to `triage-issue --prioritize-now`' — Spanish interpolation inside the ES 'untranslated' prompt and divergent trailing text. The unit edited both files in the same hunk region and left the pair inconsistent.
